test_environment: Temporary synthetic transaction roots only; no production transaction root mutation, V4 data, network, model or Agent
test_target: Future revised _find_identity classifier plus existing read_events validation under the transaction lock

tests.scenario: One valid canonical UTF-8 JSONL PREPARED journal
tests.expected: Read and validate; matching identity collision returns true, unrelated request returns false
tests.fail_closed_if: Events invalid, filename/authorization binding mismatched, or file not regular

tests.scenario: Valid AppleDouble ._<authorization_id>.jsonl with 00051607 magic beside valid canonical journal
tests.expected: Verify companion, skip only metadata; read canonical journal; no decode error
tests.fail_closed_if: Magic, companion identity, type or symlink checks fail

tests.expected: Do not include in event-journal scan
Reject the scan; never silently skip or commit
tests.fail_closed_if: Always; encoding corruption is authoritative-journal corruption

tests.scenario: Canonical journal containing invalid JSON, torn line, or invalid event sequence
tests.expected: Reject before PREPARED for the new request

tests.scenario: Existing canonical journal binds same attempt_id or namespace_id under different authorization
tests.expected: Detect duplicate identity and reject new transaction
tests.fail_closed_if: Any duplicate authorization, attempt or namespace identity

tests.expected: Read and retain committed state; unrelated fresh identity can be checked without mutating historical journal
tests.fail_closed_if: Commit markers or event identities invalid

tests.scenario: Historical burned authorization with committed journal and namespace marker
tests.expected: Existing lifecycle reducer remains terminal/non-reusable; scanner never permits reuse of that identity
tests.fail_closed_if: Reducer shows executable, or duplicate identity passes

tests.scenario: Multiple canonical journals plus a valid AppleDouble companion in varied creation orders
tests.expected: Deterministic sorted scan outcome; any collision or corruption rejects regardless of order
tests.fail_closed_if: Result depends on filesystem enumeration order

tests.scenario: Orphan ._*.jsonl, wrong magic, unreadable metadata, metadata directory or metadata symlink
tests.expected: Fail closed; do not use as ledger or silently ignore
tests.fail_closed_if: Always for an unverified journal-looking sidecar

tests.scenario: Canonical *.jsonl is a directory or symbolic link
tests.expected: Fail closed before reading or following target

tests.scenario: Transaction root is symlink or non-directory
tests.expected: Fail closed; do not scan redirected root

tests.scenario: Filename stem violates SAFE_ID or first event authorization_id differs from stem
tests.expected: Fail closed; no identity substitution or corrupt-name bypass

tests.scenario: Canonical-looking *.jsonl contains unrelated binary or is empty
tests.expected: Fail closed as ambiguous/corrupt journal rather than ignoring it

tests.scenario: macOS companion files, hidden Finder metadata, and case-distinct names on a case-insensitive temporary filesystem where available
tests.expected: Only verified AppleDouble sidecars skip; canonical collision checks remain exact; unavailable filesystem capability is explicitly reported as untested

tests.scenario: Offline crash matrix: no journal, PREPARED, COMMITTING, COMMITTED, ATTEMPT_CLAIMED, CASE_STARTED
tests.expected: Existing reconciliation and exactly-once outcomes unchanged; no automatic resume or new commit-point semantics
tests.fail_closed_if: Any transition or irreversible-burn classification changes

tests.scenario: Parity check against non-frozen Mac preflight producer's sidecar validation fixtures
tests.expected: A verified AppleDouble companion is accepted by both scanners; malformed/symlink/orphan cases fail closed in both
tests.fail_closed_if: Producer and transaction scanner disagree on an authoritative journal candidate
